A '''Separatist base''' was located on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] until it was [[Mission to Felucia (Skywalker and Kenobi)|destroyed]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The base was protected by [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking shields]].
